notes: Governmental funds are modified cash basis; business-type (enterprise) funds accrual. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p6-7); the statement rolls fund balances (cash plus interfund due from/to), so beginning_cash/ending_cash hold the beginning (as restated, 889,221.50) and ending fund balances 990,322.47 printed on p7; cash and county treasurer deposits on the balance sheet total 1,225,535.39 (p5). Operating transfers in (out) 227,757.94 net in (from Electric/Waste enterprise funds 93,235.39 and the internal service fund 134,522.55, p10); internal service fund (governmental activities, zero ending net position) not included. Business-type from proprietary Total column (p10): receipts = operating revenues + interest income (computed); disbursements total 6,790,869.79 = purchased power + operating expenses + interest expense, printed as total business-type expenses on the Statement of Activities p3. Statement of Activities business-type beginning net position 12,687,207.11 includes the internal service fund 134,159.70; proprietary statement beginning 12,553,047.41 used. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position Totals column (business-type accrual amounts, capital assets and debt). Detail: General Fund departments combining schedule (p14) per department column; from the all-funds budget schedule (p13) only the non-General Fund expenditure lines (Streets, Economic Development = Grant fund, Electric, Water, Wastewater, Sanitation) are recorded; its revenue lines and transfers out combine all funds incl. the General Fund and were not recorded to avoid double counting. Cemetery department is in the statement's Public Works function, so its lines are streets/highways. Read pages 1-14 of 14
